violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Thoroughly clean tables, shelving
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -To go items found on floor in walk-in cooler.
Plumbing system. — --Walk-in cooler: drain line from evaporator runs into a bucket instead of to the sewer

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. - Finish covering ceiling over cooking area in back room (open rafters). - Far wall by mixer needs to be finished, currently exposed installation.

Lighting. — --Lighting did not have protective shielding in areas where there is exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, or unwrapped single-service items -Back room lights must be shielded or shatterproof.
